title: Fixed native derived restriction and its monoidal data
statement: For a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ and a scheme morphism $f:Y\to X$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], package the existing native derived internal-module inverse image $\mathbf L f^*$ together with exactly its canonical strong monoidal structure [lem-sfb-derived-pullback-strong-monoidal]. The package is the pair of this functor and this structure, with no choice and with no change to its tensorator or unit. A generic package consists of a functor $F:C\to D$ between monoidal categories and a specified strong monoidal structure on $F$. The existing exact-pullback comparison $\mathbf L f^*\cong D(f^*)$ [def-sfb-left-derived-exact] gives, for every derived morphism $g$, that the packaged functor maps $g$ to an isomorphism if and only if $D(f^*)$ does.
